learning_outcomes.text: Awareness of professional and ethical responsibility
Information about awareness of entrepreneurship, innovation, and sustainable development.
Knowledge about contemporary issues and the global and societal effects of engineering practices on health, environment, and safety.

syllabus_topics: Human Requirements: Explaining Requirements, Goods and Service
Kind of Production and Factors of Production
Market Mechanism: Supply-Demand, Balance of Market, and Finding the Market Price
Effect of taxes, Policy of Government to support agriculture.
Manufacturer Theory: Concept of Cost, Average, Fixed Cost, Variable Costs
Balance of the Firm: Complete Competition and Monopoly Markets Firm Balance
Income Distribution: Functional Distribution, Lorenz curves
